H20a.claim: Primary face-value repricing becomes more frequent as the show approaches.
H20a.test: LPM: move ~ 1[0-6 days] + 1[7-13] + 1[14-20] (reference 21-29 days) + event FE + day-of-week dummies (later snapshot), no date FE (F3: date FE + event FE would make days to show collinear). One-sided test that the 0-6-day coefficient > 0.

H9p.claim: Events with wide primary price spreads (max/min >= 3 on the path's first day, a proxy for platinum/tiered pricing) reprice more often.
H9p.test: LPM: move ~ wide_spread + days-to-show bucket dummies + day-of-week dummies; two-sided test on wide_spread. wide_spread is measured as of the first path day (no look-ahead).

H20b.claim: Primary face-value changes are steps, not continuous drift.
H20b.report: daily move rate with a Wilson 95% CI on the confirmatory pairs; no test (F1: the 5% drift threshold was set after a 0.47% rate had been seen).

H37.claim: Primary face-value changes concentrate around scheduled sale-phase dates.
H37.report: the H37 LPM (near_sale_phase within 3 days after a public_sale_start or presale start/end + buckets + day of week) reported as an estimate with a CI, no p-value in BH: the registered power rule removed it from the family (MDE above 1 pp even at N = 1,000; power.json).

spec.common: Sample: events with a complete priced 30-day path (snapshots from 30 days before the show's local date through show day, a valid range on the first path day, at most 3 of 31 days missing). Unit: event-day pairs (consecutive days, both priced) whose later snapshot is 0-29 days before the show and AFTER 2026-10-21: every pair observed up to the registration date is excluded, so all tests run on unseen pairs. move = |change| > $0.005 in min or max face value. Weights: none in base. SE clustered by artist (first attraction id); p and 95% CI from t(G - 1); null-imposed wild cluster bootstrap (Webb, 1,999 draws) and leave-one-artist-out range if G < 30.
spec.ipw: IPW sensitivities: 'IPW (selection)' pools all selection days with weights 1/selection_prob; 'IPW (selection-day strata)' estimates within each selection day (the cohorts have different far shares: 60% on 2026-10-19, 30% from 2026-10-22; strata under 50 events merge into the previous day) and combines the estimates by each stratum's weight total. Pilot events have no selection_prob and drop out of both. Caveat: for the ranges pool, selection_prob is the realized share of a deliberate, diversity-capped pick, not a sampling probability, so IPW reweights toward the candidate pool's band mix and supports no statement about all US events.
